schema_version: 1
contract: course_http
route_sources:
  admin: internal/transport/http/admin/v1/router.go
  public: internal/transport/http/api/v1/router.go
  internal: internal/transport/http/private/router.go
mounts:
  - prefix: /
    audience: admin
    authentication: trusted X-User-ID and X-User-Role headers
    note: legacy unprefixed admin routes are registered intentionally
  - prefix: /admin/v1
    audience: admin
    authentication: trusted X-User-ID and X-User-Role headers
  - prefix: /api/v1
    audience: guest and authenticated readers
    authentication: optional trusted role header used for read-access policy
  - prefix: /internal
    audience: services
    authentication: X-Internal-Token shared secret
authorization:
  admin_read: [TEACHER, ADMIN, MODERATOR]
  admin_write: [ADMIN, MODERATOR]
  public: active content plus inherited lesson read-access rules
  internal: mounted when at least one internal capability token is configured; general routes use INTERNAL_API_TOKEN, generated-course writes use LEARNING_PLANNER_INTERNAL_TOKEN, and diagnostic catalog reads use DIAGNOSTIC_CATALOG_INTERNAL_TOKEN
public_resources: [catalog scopes, tracks, levels, course groups, positions, courses, outlines, modules, sections, lessons, materials, examples, semantic relations, tasks]
admin_resources: [catalog, hierarchy relations, positions, technologies, versions, tags, compose configs, code structure types, courses, i18n, modules, sections, lessons, examples, semantic relations, tasks, starter uploads, knowledge import batch]
internal_routes:
  - GET /lesson/get-internal-lesson/{lessonID}
  - GET /lesson/{lessonID}/teacher-context?language={code}
  - GET /task/get-internal-task/{taskID}
  - GET /task/get-internal-course-structure/{courseID}
  - GET /course/get-internal-course-structure/{courseID}
  - GET /course/get-internal-diagnostic-assessments/{courseID}
  - GET /course-progress/lessons
  - POST /course/resolve-lesson-bindings
  - POST /generated-courses
internal_generated_course:
  authorization: exact dedicated LEARNING_PLANNER_INTERNAL_TOKEN; the general internal token is rejected
  idempotency: required UUID Idempotency-Key; normalized body hash conflict returns 409
  fingerprint: unique by origin and fingerprint version
  lifecycle: fully generated ACTIVE Course with catalog_visible=false and ACTIVE Lessons; incomplete or planned content is rejected
  persistence: ordinary Course hierarchy, localized content, examples, quiz_theory knowledge checks, target bindings, and planning provenance in one transaction
  response: course_id, reused, and ordered lesson IDs with authoritative targets
  maximum_serialized_bytes: 16777216
  lazy_practice_material: one complete active Lesson under the normal hierarchy; fingerprint_version practice-material-fingerprint-v1; frozen route remains Practice-owned
internal_teacher_lesson_context:
  authorization: exact X-Internal-Token
  visibility: active lesson only
  localization: exact requested language or base fields with language=default
  revision: current lesson updated_at as RFC3339Nano; immutable history is not provided
  bounded_fields: [title, excerpt, description]
  intended_use: exact current selected-text verification by ms-go-teacher-agent
  forbidden_use: forwarding the full snapshot to a model when only a selected fragment is requested
internal_task_metadata:
  learning_targets: ordered opaque references with type, key, and optional version
  compatibility: learning_targets is additive and may be absent or empty for legacy tasks
internal_curriculum_projection:
  routes: ['GET /task/get-internal-course-structure/{courseID}', 'GET /course/get-internal-course-structure/{courseID}']
  ordering: lessons and tasks are sorted by authored order with stable identity tie-breaks
  revision: sha256 digest of the complete ordered lesson/task projection including updated_at and learning_targets
  additive_fields: [curriculum_revision, lesson.updated_at, task.updated_at, task.learning_targets]
  ownership: Course order and target references only; no mastery, diagnostics, or personal route state
diagnostic_assessment_projection:
  schema: course-diagnostic-assessment-catalog.v1
  route: GET /course/get-internal-diagnostic-assessments/{courseID}
  auth: exact dedicated DIAGNOSTIC_CATALOG_INTERNAL_TOKEN; general INTERNAL_API_TOKEN and LEARNING_PLANNER_INTERNAL_TOKEN are rejected
  filter: assessment_purpose=diagnostic, assessment type in [11, 12, 13], and exact evaluation_mode=AUTO
  fields: [schema, course_id, curriculum_revision, lesson, task_id, lesson_id, title, description, type, assessment_purpose, evaluation_mode, order, status, version, learning_targets, updated_at]
  bounds: at_most_100_tasks
  privacy: never includes questions, answer keys, scoring details, code_structure, or private content
compatibility:
  - route source files are authoritative for exact paths and parameters
  - do not remove the legacy unprefixed admin surface without a coordinated migration
  - public absence and forbidden hierarchy are generally hidden as not found
  - lesson read-access errors carry stable machine-readable codes documented in docs/lesson-read-access.md
lesson_revision_assignment:
  owner: ms-go-course
  schema: lesson-revision.v1
  resolve: POST /internal/lessons/{lessonID}/revision
  exact_read: GET /internal/lesson-revisions/{revisionID}
  authorization: X-Internal-Token
  fields: [schema, lesson_id, lesson_revision_id, content, activities, created_at]
  activities: [activity_id, type, required, source_reference]
  activity_types: [theory_acknowledged, quiz_passed, task_passed, practice_completed]
  private_content: trusted task snapshots include assessment keys
  forbidden_responsibility: learner satisfaction or LearningPathItem state
  cutover: legacy items retain legacy semantics without fabricated revision backfill
  author_policy: PUT /admin/v1/lesson/{lessonID}/completion-policy
t23_starter_upload_proof:
  route: POST /admin/v1/task/{taskID}/starter-files/upload
  production_components: [admin_router, TaskHandler.UploadStarterFiles, UploadStarterArchive, TaskRepoPG, TaskFileStorageRepoPG, TxManagerPG, FileStorage_HTTP_client]
  actor_metadata: existing AuthMiddleware trusts upstream X-User-ID and X-User-Role; existing ADMIN or MODERATOR write allowlist is unchanged
  multipart: files plus corresponding paths; boundary and payload bytes preserved by caller and proxy
  provider: TestT23ServeStarterUploadProvider, integration build tag, explicit T23_COURSE_PROVIDER=1 gate, root-owned finite 20 minute runtime
  isolated_database: remediation_t23_course_integration_proof, postgres user, 127.0.0.1 port 58998, TLS disabled, existing migrations applied by root only
  named_collaborators: bounded Auth POST /auth/verify and FileStorage upload/activate HTTP fixtures; no real Auth JWT, FileStorage, MinIO, code execution or publication claim
  readback: protected GET /__t23/state?task_id={ownedID}; actual PG binding plus ZIP paths, byte counts and SHA256 hashes only
  privacy: ephemeral actor and proof tokens remain in process environment and memory; readiness and journals contain no tokens or file contents
